subject: Re: Request to reserve dedicated GPUs pending contract — BluePeak Systems
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@bluepeak.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity question / potential hold for pilot

Hi Hannah,

Following up from yesterday's demo — BluePeak is close to finalizing the pilot SOW. We expect to sign within 2–3 weeks but procurement asked if we can reserve capacity now to guarantee latency during the pilot.

Target traffic: ~180–220 req/s for our inference endpoint (avg 450 tokens/session, peak 900). Preferred instance: H100-backed pool to keep 95th percentile <120ms for our model.

Can Redwood put a soft hold on 4 H100s in us-west for ~60–90 days while contracts are finalized? We'll move forward with prepayment or a short-term commitment if needed.

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of ML Platforms, BluePeak Systems
elaine@bluepeak.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity question / potential hold for pilot

Hi Elaine — great to hear the pilot is moving fast.

Short answer: we can provision a reservation-like hold but need to align on a few controls (timebox, billing trigger, and fallback policy). 

Proposal (tldr):
- Put a soft reservation on 4 H100 equivalents in us-west for up to 90 days.
- Billing: only invoiced once a DocuSign-backed purchase order or prepay is received.
- Fallback: if H100 capacity becomes constrained, we’ll provide a mixed pool (2x H100 + 4x A100-q8) with validated latency guarantees.

I’ve looped in Dylan (capacity planning) and Marcus (dedicated ops) to confirm inventory and whether we need finance sign-off for the temporary hold. Can you confirm the exact start date you’d want the hold to begin?

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity question / potential hold for pilot

Hannah / team — inventory snapshot attached. Quick summary:
- us-west pool: 6 available H100 units (after existing reserved commitments).
- We can soft-hold up to 4 H100s for 90 days, but that eats all immediate slack in the region.
- Alternative: 2 H100 + 4 A100-q8 provides ~92% of the H100 perf for most quantized configs; verified by internal bench (see "expected_p95_ms" column in CSV).

Operational notes:
- Soft-hold will mark capacity as "contingency" in the console and prevent autoscale from using it unless we run out of unreserved capacity.
- We'd like a prepay or a committed start date to avoid blocking larger enterprise commits. Without a start trigger, we keep the hold but reserve the right to release after 90 days.

Attaching: inventory_snapshot_us-west-20270506.csv

— Dylan
Capacity Planning Lead
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity question / potential hold for pilot

Internal approval checklist:
- Finance: need sign-off for holding resources (potential opportunity cost) if start date is open.
- Legal: no special T&Cs if hold is strictly non-billable until DocuSign.
- Ops: will implement a "soft hold" tag and adjust autoscale policy; requires a short maintenance window (30m) to apply.

Risk: reserving all slack in us-west may impact ability to support other late-stage deals that sign this quarter. Recommend offering BluePeak: 60-day exclusive soft-hold with an option to extend to 90 days if they provide 30% prepayment upon signature.

If everyone agrees, I can create the hold ticket and draft the ops runbook.

— Marcus
Head of Dedicated Ops
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@bluepeak.com>, procurement@bluepeak.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve dedicated GPUs pending contract — BluePeak Systems

Elaine — thanks for the details. Internal alignment completed. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of our offer:
- Soft-hold: up to 4 H100-equivalent units in us-west set aside for 60 days starting on 2027-05-10.
- Extension: one 30-day extension available if BluePeak returns a DocuSign-signed PO with 30% prepayment within the 60-day window.
- Fallback: we guarantee a mixed-pool option (2x H100 + 4x A100-q8) if pure H100 becomes unavailable; we will validate 95th pct latency against the pilot workload before cutover.
- Billing: no charges until DocuSign PO or prepay is received.

Attached: bluepeak_capacity_plan_v1.pdf (capacity sizing + perf notes).
DocuSign: I will send a short reservation agreement for signatures; we can attach to your PO.

Action items for BluePeak:
1) Confirm desired start date (we propose 2027-05-10).
2) If you want the 90-day window, confirm willingness to provide 30% prepay on signature.

If you confirm start date, Marcus will open the hold ticket and Ops will mark the capacity.

Best — Hannah
From: Elaine Park <elaine@bluepeak.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-05-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve dedicated GPUs pending contract — BluePeak Systems

Thanks Hannah — BluePeak confirms start date 2027-05-10 for the soft-hold. We prefer the 90-day window and will sign the reservation agreement with 30% prepay. Procurement will expect the DocuSign this week and will route the PO once signed.

Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of ML Platforms, BluePeak Systems
